_comment: DeepSpeed ZeRO stage 1, no offload, no custom CUDA ops. The host nvcc is 10.1 against a 12.2 driver, so any JIT build would fail; DS_BUILD_OPS=0 and a plain torch.optim.AdamW keep this path pure Python + NCCL. CPU/NVMe offload is deliberately absent for the same reason (cpu_adam would need compiling).
